snippet.title: Wonderful Neoran Valley - Welcome to the Valley Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover Wonderful Neoran Valley in the new Welcome to the Valley Trailer, focused on its main characters: the Knight (Troy Baker) meets the dragon Iris (Ben Starr), with whom he makes a deal not free of frictions.

This video contains new in-game gameplay and cinematic footage; in-game footage has been captured on PC.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5473450/Wonderful_Neoran_Valley/
Discover more: https://wonderfulneoranvalley.com
